<div class="card-body">
'''I Have You Now''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">とどめを刺すぞ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダーク・ジェダイと能力値＞２の反乱軍キャラクターが同じ戦闘に参加している時に使う。戦闘運命数をもう１枚引いて足す（反乱軍キャラクターがルークなら、２枚引ける）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-248o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「本隊から離脱したやつらを追うぞ。」ダース・ベイダーは、トレンチを進む反乱軍パイロットに、自機のブラスター・キャノンの照準を定めた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I'll finish them off.

'''Card text:''' Use when a Dark Jedi and a Rebel character with ability greater than 2 participate in the same battle. Draw and add one more battle destiny. If the Rebel is Luke, you may draw two.

'''Lore:''' “Follow the ones who broke away from the main group.” Darth Vader aimed his fighter's blaster cannon at the Rebel pilot moving down the trench.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I Have You Now]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
